plan.title: Invite two named vendors to eRFX RFQ

steps.note: Open the eRFX project creation screen.
Configure the project with RFQ as its only stage.
Move to the RFQ stage before configuring its template and items.
Apply the first available RFQ template.
Add the requested CYLINDER item with quantity 10.
Verify the requested product appears on the create screen.
Set the requested delivery location for the line item.
Verify the delivery location was retained.
Complete the RFQ pricing sheet before scheduling and publishing.
Search for and add the two named vendors only.
Commit the requested 30-minute schedule starting now.
Publish the RFQ project after all required configuration is complete.
Verify the event reached a published project page.
Open the published RFQ stage's Participants list.
Verify that exactly two vendors are participants and nobody else is listed.
Verify Vendor A is listed as a participant.
Verify Vendor B is listed as a participant.
